question: Which of the following circumstances does NOT define a patient with chronic pathology?

options.opa: A 66-year-old woman diagnosed with hypertension, Crohn's disease, type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic retinopathy.
options.opb: 75-year-old ex-smoker, FEV1 75%, IMC 25, creatinine 1.2, anxiety-depressive syndrome. Pfeiffer 30 and Barthel 100.
options.opc: An 82-year-old man diagnosed with osteoarthritis, with Barthel 40, hypertension and pharmacologically controlled dyslipidemia and Alzheimer's disease.
options.opd: A 55-year-old ex-smoker, diagnosed with symptomatic peripheral arteriopathy and ulcerative colitis.
options.ope: A 70-year-old man with enolism, portal hypertension and immobilized at home for 5 years by ACV.
